## Project: CodeWhale

**Purpose:** CodeWhale is an open-source, community-driven terminal agent harness (TUI + CLI) written in Rust. It is designed to work with **any LLM provider** — with a first-class focus on open-weight models (DeepSeek, local vLLM/SGLang/Ollama) — while natively supporting closed providers like Anthropic Claude and OpenAI. The core philosophy is that safety and policy should live in the **harness**, not in the model prompt: approval gates, OS sandboxing (bwrap, Landlock, Seatbelt, seccomp), git-based rollback, and a constitution system for project-level rules are runtime mechanisms the model cannot override.

## Top-Level Directory Structure (key items)

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `crates/` | 16 Rust crates (workspace) – the main codebase |
| `docs/` | Documentation (install, provider registry, architecture, etc.) |
| `web/` | Web-related assets (likely codewhale.net) |
| `integrations/` | External integrations |
| `workflows/` | Workflow definitions |
| `extensions/` | Extension mechanisms (MCP, etc.) |
| `scripts/` | Build/helper scripts |
| `deploy/` | Deployment configs |
| `assets/` | Screenshots, branding |
| `npm/` | npm wrapper package |
| `nix/` | Nix flake support |
| `Cargo.toml` | Workspace root (Rust) |
| `README.md` | Primary README (English) |
| `AGENTS.md` | Agent/contributor guidance (sub-agent behavior) |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | Release changelog |
| `CONTRIBUTING.md` | Contribution guide |
| `config.example.toml` | Example configuration |
| `Dockerfile` | Docker build |

## Key Crates (agent/harness/runtime related)

These Rust crates under `/tmp/CodeWhale/crates/` are directly relevant:

- **`agent`** (`crates/agent/lib.rs`, ~64KB) — Agent logic, sub-agent lifecycle, and tool orchestration. Implements the sub-agent architecture described in the README (concurrent agents with provider-aware routing, tiers, output contracts).
- **`core`** (`crates/core/lib.rs`, ~96KB) — Core runtime harness: tool system, approval gates, sandboxing, session management, constitution enforcement. This is the central harness.
- **`cli`** — CLI entry point (`codewhale`, `codew`). Headless exec mode, provider auth, doctor checks.
- **`tui`** / **`tui-core`** — Terminal UI (ratatui-based), interactive session.
- **`execpolicy`** — Execution policy engine (approval gates, deny-wins, hooks).
- **`whaleflow`** — Declarative workflow orchestration (WhaleFlow).
- **`hooks`** — Hook system (v2, `tool_call_before` with JSON decisions).
- **`mcp`** — MCP (Model Context Protocol) support for external tool servers and acting as an MCP server.
- **`state`** — Session state management, memory (durable sessions, cross-session cache).
- **`protocol`** — Wire protocol adapters (native Anthropic `/v1/messages`, OpenAI dialect, etc.).
- **`app-server`** — HTTP/SSE runtime API for headless/mobile/GUI integration.
- **`tools`** — Tool implementations (file, shell, git, web, sub-agent).
- **`config`** — Configuration loading and management.
- **`secrets`** — Secret/credentials management.
- **`release`** — Release automation.

- `/tmp/CodeWhale/README.md` (first 120 lines + full fetch) – project purpose, install, features
- `/tmp/CodeWhale/AGENTS.md` – agent guidance (sub-agent behavior, release integration)
- `/tmp/CodeWhale/crates/` listing – all 16 workspace crates
- `/tmp/CodeWhale/crates/agent/src/lib.rs`, `/tmp/CodeWhale/crates/core/src/lib.rs` – confirmed large source files implementing agent harness and core runtime
